mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS id, w.gmt_create AS createdAt FROM workitem w WHERE ORDER BY w.gmt_create, w.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workitem w WHERE

SELECT w.id AS id, w.title AS title, sn.name AS statusName, sn.category AS statusCategory, w.priority AS priority, w.gmt_create AS createdAt FROM workitem w LEFT JOIN status_node sn ON sn.id = w.status_node_id AND sn.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE ORDER BY w.gmt_create DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT w.id AS id, (SELECT MAX(e.gmt_create) FROM workitem_event e JOIN status_node done_node ON done_node.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND done_node.code = e.to_val AND done_node.category = 'DONE' WHERE e.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND e.workitem_id = w.id AND e.event_type = 'STATUS_CHANGE' AND done_node.template_id = w.template_id) AS delivered_at FROM workitem w JOIN status_node sn ON sn.id = w.status_node_id AND sn.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND sn.category = 'DONE' ) delivered WHERE delivered.delivered_at >= #{start} AND delivered.delivered_at < #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workitem w WHERE

SELECT w.id AS id, w.title AS title, sn.name AS statusName, AS statusCategory, w.priority AS priority, w.gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM workitem w LEFT JOIN status_node sn ON sn.id = w.status_node_id AND sn.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE ORDER BY CASE WHEN 'PENDING_DECISION' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, w.priority ASC, w.gmt_modified DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
